items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Lil' Walker's best colored piano player, they said.

ctx.x: Wasn't too far from Sam Picks. Sam Picks. Yes. This is a great piano player. I forget his name was playing as Sam Picks, wasn't he? No. Lil' Walker's best colored piano player, they said. I forget his name.
